note: Exporter of motor-vehicle spare parts (seals, sleeves, gaskets, front-teeth assy) from Delhi (2620/B Hamilton Road, Kashmere Gate) to Nepal (Bhairawa, Birgunj) and Sri Lanka (Colombo) — real customs records with dates, destinations, HS codes and BOL numbers, so export_status is confirmed, not merely declared. Declared HS 848210 (ball bearings) does not match the observed codes (84828000, 84213100, 84841090, 87085000, 40169330); per project rule 3 this is not a rejection ground — actual HS should be corrected to the observed codes and verdict treated as accepted_hs_corrected. Role: trader/exporter of auto parts (buys from Supremo Auto Parts, Mohan Motors, Rane (Madras), Federal-Mogul Goetze, Sudarsan Madras Engineering per buyer/supplier tables) — manufacturer_trader/unknown, not a metals & mining company as claimed. Domestic India supply evidence (GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tenders, contracts, annual-report splits) could not be retrieved: DuckDuckGo/searx search backend returned 'Connection refused' on all attempts and volza returned HTTP 403, so domestic_status is unknown, not none_found. Revenue and export volume figures: null — not public on free views. Note the second slug (r-k-automobiles-pvt-ltd) returned an empty record with no shipments, so the legal name should be recorded as R. K. AUTOMOBILES PRIVATE LIMITED (Delhi).
